exceptionImpacts.affectsNote: A collective holding with no stated split means an individual seller's share is unknown, so what is actually being bought is undefined.
exceptionImpacts.unquantifiedReason: ECONOMIC IMPACT NOT YET QUANTIFIABLE. No split is stated in the instrument, and equal shares are never assumed.
exceptionImpacts.resolution: Obtain the recorded image to check for per-grantee fractions, or locate a later partition instrument.
exceptionImpacts.decisionEffectNote: Not priceable from evidence of this kind. Must still be cured or waived before closing; pricing it does not remove it. Can change the posture or the price a buyer would pay.

exceptionImpacts.issue: Three instruments known from index only
exceptionImpacts.evidence: Three county index entries fall within the search period but their document text was not obtained. An index entry establishes that a record exists; it does not establish what the instrument conveyed.
exceptionImpacts.affectsNote: Instruments known only from a county index have not been read, so their effect on the estate is unknown.
exceptionImpacts.unquantifiedReason: ECONOMIC IMPACT NOT YET QUANTIFIABLE. An unread instrument may convey anything or nothing; assigning it a value would be fabrication.
exceptionImpacts.resolution: Order the recorded images for all three and re-run the reconstruction.
exceptionImpacts.decisionEffectNote: Not priceable from evidence of this kind. Does not by itself prevent closing. Can change the posture or the price a buyer would pay.
